name: issue-rca-build-swarm
description: Sandbox configuration combining the build swarm (oshal-engineering — code construction) with the issue-rca swarm (standard incident investigation). Legacy product integrations + Little Monsters are off; no AWS / Kubernetes / Gardener creds are seeded; Anthropic auth via the host's ~/.claude OAuth mount only. Operators see a unified ticket queue containing both `build` and `incident` tickets, filterable by ticketType.
